rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when get means obtain or receive something.

example.english: I finally get a ticket to the concert.
example.traditional: 我終於攞到張演唱會飛喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou3 zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui6 fei1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when get means possess something or indicate that something exists in a place or situation.

example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 mou5 seon3 hou6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when get means understand an idea, explanation, or joke.

example.english: I get why you did that.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 dim2 gaai2 gam2 zou6

rows.note: Use this when get means enter or bring oneself into a new state or condition.

example.english: I get really lazy when the weather turns cold.
example.traditional: 天氣一凍，我就變得好懶。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jat1 dung3 ngo5 zau6 bin3 dak1 hou2 laan5
